verdict.rationale: Reporting on fraud KPIs is a fair axis for a fraud-prevention platform, but the evidence pack never documents dashboards or exportable reports for dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, or review workload. Marketing claims such as "approve more" and "drop manual review up to 80%" are outcome promises, not reporting features. The passing mention of an "Explore" console view does not describe metrics or export.
